Muc luc qua Next.js Server Action actionGetChaptersOfBook (ID c05deb810402fe1998675d59adb521ecd6cf5592f2), 100 chuong/trang; POST tu VM bi treo (tarpit IP datacenter) nen chi kiem chung tren may that; toc.js co fallback sinh chuong 1..tong tu so chuong tren trang chi tiet. Server Action tra 50 chuong/trang (trang 1 = ch.1-50, trang 11 = ch.501-550, trang 22 = ch.1051-1068) du gui limit=100 — page.js chia 50 chuong/trang (1.068 chuong = 22 trang).
